Rationale.CS1_Results_vs_Conclusion: All evaluable conclusions in the documentation match the results originally recorded in the implementation. Key verified claims include: (1) 48% of relations achieved >60% faithfulness on GPT-J (verified via Table 10), (2) LRE outperformed all baselines (Identity, Translation, Linear Regression) as shown in Figure 4 and scripts/baselines/, (3) Company CEO showed <6% faithfulness (verified: 0.06±0.03 in Table 10), (4) R=0.84 correlation between faithfulness and causality (verified via Figure 6), (5) Cross-model correlations GPT-J vs GPT-2-XL: R=0.85 and GPT-J vs LLaMA-13B: R=0.71 (verified via Figure 16), (6) Attribute lens recovered 54-63% R@1 on distracted prompts (verified via Table 3 showing 0.54 R@1 for repetition-distracted). All 47 relations have cached LRE results and hyperparameters for GPT-J.
Rationale.CS2_Plan_vs_Implementation: All plan steps appear in the implementation. Methodology verification: (1) LRE extraction via JacobianIclMeanEstimator found in operators.py, (2) Faithfulness evaluation found in benchmarks.py, (3) Causality evaluation via LowRankPInvEditor found in editors.py, (4) Multi-model testing (GPT-J, GPT-2-XL, LLaMA-13B) found in models.py. Experiment verification: All 6 planned experiments implemented - (1) LRE Faithfulness in notebooks/figures/faithfulness.ipynb, (2) LRE Causality in notebooks/figures/causality.ipynb, (3) Layer-wise LRE Performance in notebooks/layer_search.ipynb, (4) Baseline Comparison in scripts/baselines/, (5) Attribute Lens in demo/attribute_lens.ipynb and src/attributelens/, (6) Cross-Model Analysis with hparams for all 3 models. Dataset of 47 relations across 4 categories (factual: 26, commonsense: 8, linguistic: 6, bias: 7) verified in data/ folder.
